title: Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability that…
description: Sustainsys.Saml2 versions before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 have an improper signature verification vulnerability. This flaw allows attackers to tamper with signed parameters by exploiting a parsing issue in the CheckSignature() function of Saml2RedirectBinding.cs. Specifically, attackers can append data after an extra '=' character in the RelayState parameter of a Redirect-binding message, causing the application to trust the manipulated value.
